prompt:
You are checking which candidate answer correctly answers a question about a SQL database.

Question:
For each rating category of the first movie rented by customers—where the first movie is identified based on the earliest payment date per customer—please provide the average total amount spent per customer and the average number of subsequent rentals (calculated as the total number of rentals minus one) for customers whose first rented movie falls into that rating category.

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

[A]
SQL:
WITH first_payment_per_customer AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MIN(payment_date) as first_payment_date
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
first_payment_with_tiebreaker AS (
    SELECT 
        fpc.customer_id,
        fpc.first_payment_date,
        p.payment_id,
        p.rental_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fpc.customer_id ORDER BY p.payment_date, p.payment_id) as rn
    FROM payment p
    JOIN first_payment_per_customer fpc ON p.customer_id = fpc.customer_id AND p.payment_date = fpc.first_payment_date
),
first_payment_record AS (
    SELECT customer_id, payment_id, rental_id
    FROM first_payment_with_tiebreaker
    WHERE rn = 1
),
first_rental AS (
    SELECT 
        fp.customer_id,
        p.rental_id
    FROM first_payment_record fp
    JOIN payment p ON p.payment_id = fp.payment_id
),
first_movie_details AS (
    SELECT 
        fr.customer_id,
        f.rating
    FROM first_rental fr
    JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = fr.rental_id
    JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
    JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
),
customer_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        COUNT(*) as total_rentals,
        SUM(amount) as total_amount
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT 
    fmd.rating,
    COUNT(*) as num_customers,
    ROUND(AVG(cs.total_amount), 2) as avg_total_amount,
    ROUND(AVG(cs.total_rentals - 1), 2) as avg_subsequent_rentals
FROM first_movie_details fmd
JOIN customer_stats cs ON cs.cu

[B]
SQL:
WITH first_payment_per_customer AS (
    SELECT customer_id, payment_id, rental_id, payment_date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_date ASC) as rn
    FROM payment
),
first_rental_per_customer AS (
    SELECT customer_id, rental_id, payment_date
    FROM first_payment_per_customer
    WHERE rn = 1
),
first_movie_rating AS (
    SELECT fp.customer_id, fi.rating
    FROM first_rental_per_customer fp
    JOIN rental r ON fp.rental_id = r.rental_id
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    JOIN film fi ON i.film_id = fi.film_id
),
customer_totals AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           SUM(amount) as total_amount,
           COUNT(rental_id) as total_rentals,
           COUNT(DISTINCT rental_id) as distinct_rentals
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_with_first_rating AS (
    SELECT fm.customer_id, fm.rating, ct.total_amount, ct.total_rentals, ct.distinct_rentals
    FROM first_movie_rating fm
    JOIN customer_totals ct ON fm.customer_id = ct.customer_id
)
SELECT rating,
       AVG(total_amount) as avg_total_amount,
       AVG(total_rentals - 1) as avg_subsequent_rentals
FROM customer_with_first_rating
GROUP BY rating
ORDER BY rating

SQL:
WITH first_payment AS (
    SELECT customer_id, payment_id, rental_id
    FROM (
        SELECT customer_id, payment_id, rental_id,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_date) as rn
        FROM payment
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
first_rental AS (
    SELECT fp.customer_id, fp.rental_id
    FROM first_payment fp
),
first_film AS (
    SELECT fr.customer_id, fr.rental_id, r.inventory_id, i.film_id
    FROM first_rental fr
    JOIN rental r ON fr.rental_id = r.rental_id
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
),
first_rating AS (
    SELECT ff.customer_id, ff.film_id, f.rating
    FROM first_film ff
    JOIN film f ON ff.film_id = f.film_id
),
customer_amount AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, SUM(p.amount) as total_amount
    FROM customer c
    JOIN payment p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
),
customer_rentals AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT r.rental_id) as total_rentals
    FROM customer c
    LEFT JOIN rental r ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    fr.rating,
    AVG(ca.total_amount) as avg_total_amount,
    AVG(cr.total_rentals - 1) as avg_subsequent_rentals
FROM first_rating fr
JOIN customer_amount ca ON fr.customer_id = ca.customer_id
JOIN customer_rentals cr ON fr.customer_id = cr.customer_id
GROUP BY fr.rating
ORDER BY fr.rating

SELECT 
    fm.rating,
    AVG(p.total_amount) as avg_total_amount,
    AVG(CAST(r.total_rentals AS DOUBLE) - 1) as avg_subsequent_rentals
FROM (
    SELECT

) p
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT

        COUNT(*) as total_rentals
    FROM rental r

) r ON p.customer_id = r.customer_id
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT 
        p.customer_id,
        p.payment_id,
        r.inventory_id,
        i.film_id,
        f.rating
    FROM payment p
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT customer_id, MIN(payment_date) as first_payment_date

    ) fp ON p.customer_id = fp.customer_id AND p.payment_date = fp.first_payment_date
    INNER JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
    INNER JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    INNER JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
) fm ON p.customer_id = fm.customer_id
GROUP BY fm.rating
ORDER BY fm.rating
